purpose: Where to get the source of the GCC runtime libraries (libgfortran, libquadmath, libgomp) that the NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn and PyTorch wheels in the images carry, and of the NumPy, SciPy and scikit-learn releases themselves. Each library is identified by its GNU build ID and the SHA-256 of the file as it sits in the NVIDIA main image.

The library records no package version, so no exact GCC release is named here. GCC's libgomp source is published in the GCC project's public source tree (https://gcc.gnu.org/git/?p=gcc.git;a=tree;f=libgomp) and in its release archives at https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gcc/.

mappedBinaryPackages.officialChecksum: No repodata/checksum was available at the exact buildlogs package directory; SHA256 is locally observed over the official HTTPS download.

mappedBinaryPackages.license: The NumPy and SciPy wheel notices declare libgfortran GPL-3.0 with GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1. The matching source tree carries COPYING.RUNTIME; the exception is limited to covered runtime code and does not remove the source-delivery obligation.

limits: The PyTorch 2.6.0 libgomp copy (build ID 5f4fb88a...) records no package version; only the public GCC source tree is named for it.

The AMD satellite image's Python environment was read: it carries the same NumPy 1.26.4, SciPy 1.17.1 and scikit-learn 1.9.1 library copies as the NVIDIA main image (same build IDs and SHA-256 values) and no libgomp in PyTorch's ROCm wheel. The other Python environments of the AMD main image were not read for this record.
